description: Search Engine Optimization best practices for web pages

rules.rule: Every page must have exactly one H1 tag
rules.reasoning: H1 is the primary signal to search engines about page topic. Multiple H1s confuse crawlers; zero H1s miss a critical ranking opportunity.

rules.rule: Meta title should be between 50 and 60 characters
rules.reasoning: Titles under 50 chars miss keyword opportunities. Titles over 60 chars get truncated in Google SERPs, hurting click-through rates.

rules.rule: Meta description should be between 150 and 160 characters
rules.reasoning: Meta descriptions are the preview snippet in Google. Too short wastes the opportunity; too long gets cut off.

rules.rule: Pages should have a minimum of 300 words for SEO value
rules.reasoning: Search engines consider thin content (under 300 words) low-value. Competitive pages typically have 800-1500 words.

rules.rule: Pages should have at least 2 H2 tags to structure content
rules.reasoning: H2s help search engines understand content hierarchy and improve crawlability of long-form content.

rules.rule: Less than 10% of images should be missing alt text
rules.reasoning: Alt text is an SEO signal for image search. Missing alt text also violates WCAG accessibility standards.
